description:
TOP EXPERIENCE IN MADRID WITH ALMOST 800 HUNDRED REVIEWS!
Join us in an amazing group of international people to discover the fun side of Madrid nightlife, make new friends and party!
We are going to hit some of the coolest bars/pubs in the center while having a good time and getting along with others, locals and travelers, meet new people, talk, and dance like jagger, just don't stay home!
Let's hop from bar to bar with tequila shots, games, discounts on drinks

Everyone is welcome and the age range is wide as the nationalities involved in the experience.
We will be reduced groups to make it better and safer during the current conditions.
The group will be always in a safe area for girls and guys.

MEETING POINT: Next to the statue of the bear and the straberry tree (Oso y el Madroño) at Puerta del Sol square, at 10:00pm.
If you can't arrive on time, let me know by sending me a message to +34653921963 I'll try my best to let you know where we are and send you the location.

Okay, now the plan is set, it's time to ride on!

Dress Code: The only thing not allowed are joggers or sporty pants and t-shirts wihtout sleeves. --Short pants are allowed-
Other things to note:
if you can't arrive exactly at the time set, we will be there until 10:20 approx.
locationDescription:
Meeting Point: Next to the statue of the bear and the straberry tree (Oso y el Madroño) at Puerta del Sol at 22:00
We are going to 3 or 4 bars with all kind of music, playing games on the way, drinking, tequila, special discounts on drinks for us and meeting new cool people along the way! (all included)

reviews.text: These tour guides are amazing! Young nice guys who show you the best bars and especially clubs with the best dj's, and this even on monday! Thanks a lot it was great and I would recommend it to everyone. An unforgettable experience!
Definitely book this experience! I met so many other solo travelers and became great friends with them and even met up with some of them the next day.
10/10 would recommend. You have to do this if you’re ever in Madrid, especially as a solo traveller! Met lots of fun people, went to the best bars and clubs. The best pub crawl yet!

Don’t even second guess it, book this experience. It’s the easiest way to make new friends from all over the world. I travelled solo and went on my first night and last night in Madrid. I spent the rest of my trip hanging out with the friends I made on both nights. I’m even returning to Madrid again to party with some girls I met on this crawl. The hosts were all great and go out of their way to look after you. I didn’t spend any money on drinks since you get a shot in every club (apart from one we went to.)
Great time. Around 100 people at the pub crawl when I went. Plenty of people to get to know and socialize with. The tour guides also provided glow sticks and champaign which was nice.
New friends and good times. This event is for the young or young at heart. It will definitely test your endurance. You visit several bars and clubs. Gives you a good idea of the Madrid party scene.

This is a great way to meet lots of people and hit a few locations while skipping the lines. It’s gonna be a crazy night so be cool and enjoy the ride. They do a great job of herding cats in a bustling city.
Amazing experience. You meet new people, and you go from bar to bar drinking shots. If I ever return to Madrid, I wouldn't hesitate to do it again!!
The groups are too big, the event started almost an hour late and they took us to clubs that wouldn't fit... you couldn't even dance.
Super fun pub crawl and a great way to meet people in the city. Stayed out until 6:30am that night (though you certainly don't have to!) and had a great time.
the crawl was great for meeting new people and getting to know them. the bars and clubs were not too great and we ended up only going to 4 places instead of 5.
Totally surpassed my expectations! Great way to go out without worrying about looking up places or safety issues. Totally fun environment and it was great meeting people from all over the world!

This experience was fantastic and effective for my trip.
For solo travelers, it's an incredible and unique alternative to making friends in the same situation as you.

Undoubtedly, I highly recommend this activity as early as the first day in Madrid.
We had a great night out on the pub craw. Would recommend to anyone visiting Madrid to get to know the places to go and meet new people! Free shot at every bar also which was great value
Will was a huge host. We never left it alone and took us to a good place at the right time. He made me feel very reliable and safe. I highly recommend it. It was the best.

I went to the experience without any expectations and with the idea of coming back at home of I get bored. I ended staying until 5 a.m with new friends and an amazing memory of Madrid by night. Michael is sweet, I definitely will go again!

Will was my host and was great overall! He really knows Madrid! He made sure my group had a good time and I appreciate him for that! He was great at keeping the group together and making sure we all had a good time. I ended up making friends and staying out until 4aM that morning… it was a Thursday. Really great experience in Madrid for sure! Book this ASAP. You won’t regret it.

Great experience for those who are the life of the party! There are lots of people who showed up last minute delaying the night about 30-40 minutes, but it was not a big deal. The clubs were a bit small for the amount of people who joined. Overall, a good experience.
Honestly you need to do this if you’re in madrid! I met so many people from all over and it was so fun!

It was a great experience to meet people and get into Madrid's nightlife
Michael and the other hosts are very friendly, I recommend it if you're traveling alone
We had a great time on the pub crawl! We got to meet a lot of new people and explore some great new spots in Madrid.
It was great, we were a group of about 25 people and had a great time. We didn't wait in line, and they gave us a shot at every place.

Great way to meet new people in the city. Very international group and the bars/discotecas were super fun. Starts a little early in the night for Spain, but that’s kinda the fun of it. Overall I had a great time and would go back.

This was a lot of fun. Will was our guide, he was very friendly and social. We were able to meet up with other groups from the save event and do a language exchange. Everyone was very friendly and it was very cool to be able to meet so many people from different countries

If you’re not from around and you’re looking for a way to be introduced to the Madrid nightlife, this is the way. Met new people from everywhere, friendly, fun, and a great way to get out of your comfort zone! Would definitely do it again!

I had Will as the tour guide and he is great, he just knows everybody in the streers downtown and we skipped the line in all the bars. The places we went to were fun. I recommend this experience specially during the weekends
Met some fun people and a good way to meet others if you’re solo, though the host wasn’t very engaged with the group.

such a great & fun way to meet new people while exploring Madrid! You have to book this pub crawl, you will not regret it. Jonathan & Danny were awesome. I had the best time on my last night in Madrid :)
We all quickly bonded and before you knew it we was all on the dance floor. Great experience cannot fault it. Left the experience with few new friends. 10 out of 10
must do if solo travaller. had the best time and then slotted into group of girlfriends for the remainder of my stay. hosts really make an effort!

It was fun but not what I expected. The host said he would message the day of but he never did. Ended up being a really big group 20+ as it merged with a meetup group. Good time though, just very anonymous.
This was the perfect way to meet new people as a solo traveler! All the venues and locations were very interesting and the whole group seemed to form a great bond with each other.
Good experience, good group and lots of laughs. This was my first time trying this kind of experience. Just a shame we have little interaction with the locals.
I just recommend… they'll get bored and won't talk to anyone if they're bored or outgoing. In general, 👌🏽 good places to visit are good.

Amazing way to experience nightlife in Madrid while meeting cool people! The hosts know how to make sure you have a good time, with good people, at great locations. Whether it’s your first night or your last — you must join!

It was such an incredible night! 🤩 I had the chance to experience the nightlife of Madrid and at the same time build good connections with people from both the city and from all over the world. I can recommend it to everyone, especially for those who are traveling solo.

I had an excellent time. In the bars they gave us a shot of something like tequila, which is not very rich. But anyway, I'm Mexican and in that drink I'm naturally more demanding. Nice and fun people.
10/10 experience! Such a great way to meet new people especially as a solo traveller! Had the best time! The bars/clubs were so much fun! Would 100% do it again!

This was a unique experience but a great way to get a glimpse into Madrid's nightlife. I would not recommend going alone as it is a mixed bag of individuals but would be fun to go with a group. The drink vouchers given make up for the cost of the program alone!
was a great way to meet people and see cool parts of the city! plus getting at least one free drink at each place definitely made the value worth it!

One of the highlights of our trip! A must-do for everyone visiting. It’s a great way to experience the nightlife and make new friends! All the locations were absolutely incredible and we had the best time ever!! Will definitely be joining this experience again once I’m back!
I had a great time, it has a very nice atmosphere throughout the group, we took care of each other, ideal for people who travel and want to go for a party accompanied

probably the best paid party experience I've had.
At most of the places you will visit on this tour, the first drink is free.
Very good experience, really the party in Madrid doesn't stop. I made new friends and had a great time.
It was very fun... I didn't know the nightlife of Madrid and I really wanted to live the experience again... I hope to return soon... Regards

Lots of fun, definitely recommend as a solo traveler! Great way to meet people and the hosts went out of their way to make sure everyone knew when the group was moving to the next place. Also a great value given the all the free drink coupons!!

First time in Madrid? Don’t miss this experience. I met a great group of people who I hung out with for the remainder of my time in Madrid. I truly recommend this experience if you like to party and are on your own.
I had a good time, the tour is good and the price of the promotions too. It's worth taking. You meet new people to connect with.

The night out was fun, we did karaoke at a bar that got a good feeling as the night went through, and afterwards we went to a disco which was what you would expect from a disco - music, drinks, and dancing. However I expected to go around a bit more to other pubs or places, but still had a fun night. Also group was kind of small the day I went, but that was mainly bad luck on my part as it was a thursday, and the best days are probably friday and saturday.

A really enjoyable evening meeting new people from around the world and experiencing what Madrid’s nightlife has to offer! Would definitely recommend to solo travellers and groups and will do again when I’m next in Madrid! Thank you for the great experience!
So much fun and a great way to meet friendly people. The spots were cool and the drinks were tasty. Definitely worth the price!
Wonderful ! I had a great time , we visited very good places, I recommend this experience , it's excellent !!

We had a great time on this experience! Met a lot of great people - combination of tourists/visitors and people who live in Madrid, we really liked meeting some locals. The places were all great and good prices everywhere we went! Definitely would recommend and would do this again next time in Madrid.

If you're in the mood for a tour of a few bars and clubs, this is the place to be. Dear people and good mood included.
However, I found it a pity that there were very high, hidden costs in the form of "special offers" in the respective clubs... For the predominant audience (18-23),
such pub crawls, however, could be too expensive.

It started off good with a larger group than expected but still without any major problems, got to know other group members quite well. When it came to the third club one was skipped and we were brought to the grand opening of a new club where they tried to charge us 25€ while we argued the bar crawl price with the host nowhere to be found to help us. I would have appreciated if the host ensured everyone was inside safely before going inside himself. He seemed inconvenienced. The club we went into felt a bit uncomfortable and did not match what was expected by most of the group. He did bring us to another club after, and offered a single drink to our group of 8 that had been together that night to make up for it. Also, definitely for a younger crowd, which was good for us but just as a heads up.
Was so much better than we could have imagined! Met loads of great people from around the world and Jonathan was the best host. Would definitely recommend!
My friends and I had an amazing time during this pub-crawl. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to meet new people and have a great night out in Madrid
Definitely an experience that all foreign and foreign should try. I met people who have taken the tour for years. I met many new and interesting people and had a great time.

A great experience if you are traveling just feel free to book. I met new friends with whom I was then able to meet during my trip to Madrid. Celebrate my birthday with them and they were very attentive and fun :)

Wonderful experience. Nice way to start my vacation. Great value for the price. Our host was wonderful and attentive. He was always checking on us and making sure that we were having fun and that we were not staying behind when moving to the next bar. La mejor manera de conocer gente y nuevos lugares.
They should give the itinerary of the bars or a contact who is actually working on that they in case people get lost
Had such an awesome time. Everyone was extremely sweet and if you’re alone in Spain and you’re interested in making friends you 100% need to check this experience out!!! 10/10
This was a great choice to ensure a great night. The hosts were all so relatable and likeable and that truly opened up the opportunity to make new friends, which I did. Highly recommended.
Magnificent experience, if you want to go out of pubs and discos in Madrid feel free to book, what a party!! 100% satisfied.
one of the best decisions I have made !!! Micheal & team is fabulous and cares about each and every participant's happiness and works towards that... 10/10 would do it again and again and again

This event is awesome to meet new people from around the world. Great for solo travelers and people who love to party! Definitely worth the price as you get multiple drinks throughout the night! Highly recommend.

What a great experience, especially if you’re solo traveling. I met a lot of interesting and fun people from all over. The price is cheap for everything they provide. Entry into clubs, a shot once you’re inside and they take you to a few different clubs so it’s a nice variety. Music was primarily reggaeton. ❤️

this was a really fun experience and a great way to make some friends and visit some fun bars and clubs in Madrid! I felt safe and felt that this was a fun contrast to some of the heavier cultural and artistic and historical parts of my trip

The tour was a little bit impersonal for me. I expected to meet the host and maybe go out with a few other people. As a solo traveler I wanted a more intimate experience. But the group size was more than 30 people and I didn’t end up really meeting anyone as most people already arrived in their own groups. I also think that the clubs they went to were too touristy.

The first three bars are good . Hosts are friendly. The only problem there was is that in the ad it appears that the entrance to the nightclub is free and we had to pay 15 euros. If you have to pay for a ticket to the nightclub , it would be good for you to notify in advance!
We had an amazing time. I can only recommend this to anyone visiting Madrid and is looking to meet some new people. We danced through the night. 10/10

was a nice experience and good value as we were able to skip the line cover included and vip stylr and 1 drink for 5 venues so was a good saving to club hop. also was fun to party with a group of people you can meet from all over the world. i reccomend for solo travlers or party people to maxinmize their night out
Great way to meet friends especially if you’re a solo traveler! I had a great night out and would definitely do it again when back in Madrid!
Would definitely recommend this experience if you're looking for a really fun night out! Met a lot of new people, everyone was super friendly and the pubs that we went to were so much fun!

Easily the perfect way to start or end your trip. You meet new people and the hosts are so accommodating. They even took photos of us throughout the night :)

10/10 would recommend & go again ✨👏
If you are a young solo traveler I 100% recommend this. You merry so many new people and also the organizers are great with keeping track of you!
I liked it a lot and can fully recommend it for people who are new in Madrid and want to connect and enjoy the bars and clubs in the city center. The host was very organized and friendly.
Definitely not a pub crawl but if you like crowded dance clubs with loud music and lots of younger people in their 20's, u would probably love it
good night out. taken to good bars in the area. music is a personal thing but it was all to my taste. definitely a worthwhile night out!

This was the highlight of our Madrid trip. We were running a little late and Host waited for us to catch up. All the club host were kind and everyone was respectful. We are looking forward to returning soon!
Great experience. Great places, great for visiting Madrid night. Very considerate host. Going beyond my expectations. 100% recommend.
This experience was amazing! I am from the United States and made some great friends in the group/clubs and had some memorable experiences!!
Very fun, pleasant walk with people from many different places... they are always attentive to your needs or doubts
Good experience for those who want to experience the nightlife and have a good time out at bars and clubs. I wouldn't recommend this experience for solo travelers.
It was an amazing night with this group. I didn't really know what it would be like, but I enjoyed the group so much, and I met such friendly and fun guys. Thank you for organizing it!

It was really fun, I met a lot of people!
If you are young and want to go out in Madrid, this is the experience for you!

Awesome experience!! I thought it would be awkward, but the people in our group were great. You really make the atmosphere and it’s up to you to have a good time. We got shots that were included w the Airbnb price and discounts. We also got a shot from Michael which was awesome! I definitely recommend if you’re new to Madrid.
This is my second time doing this experience and it great value for the money. An awesome way to meet people in Madrid and you get to see some nice places.

Was a worth while experience! Jonathon and Michael are focused to ensure everyone have a good time and everything goes smooth.

Met Rita as well who was not only super friendly, but a crazy dancer with great vibes.

Recommend the experience to anyone visiting.

The experience was great. The places were really good, the people were so nice and Michael is a great host. He was so helpful even with recommendation that had nothing to do with the tour. I highly suggest the experience

I had a lot of fun at this Pubcrawl, there was people of all ages and nationalities, if you are really looking for having a great and safe night, then I really recommend you to try this party tour.
Thanks to the hosts Jonathan and Michael I made new friends in Madrid!
Thank you guys

It was a very rewarding experience! very well organized. Michael and Jonathan were very outgoing and respectful people, always smiling and making sure everybody was having a great time! Definitely worth repeating again.
Good tour, recommended for young people who do not have many friends/acquaintances in Madrid and want to get to know the nightlife.

This experience was stellar! In Madrid for a short time and was celebrating the Thanksgiving holiday with a friend. We booked this experience to meet some folks and see the nightlife here. Such an amazing time! Do yourself a favor and book yours soon, you won't regret it! Be prepared to drink, dance and dance some more. Well done muchachos! See you again soon.
Met a lot of new friends that I ended up meeting later during my trip in Madrid. Had a lot of fun honestly!

*review from a 30 year old’s experience* The host was great, very friendly. And I think this is a great bar crawl, for folks who are in their early to maybe mid 20’s. It was a little awkward, because it felt like everyone was younger and wanting to get “wasted” but this isnt the hosts fault, I just wanted to provide an additional perspective if someone who’s in their 30’s is considering booking this.

Great experience! Met a lot of people and made friends with people I see everyday now! Super fun and engaging, this is perfect if you don’t know the spots in Madrid and it’s a great way to make new friends in a new country! They give you tips and advice, loved the experience!

Michael and the other host are super nice . This was not the right choice for me, I did not like the places we went. I felt like in high school , a lot people who are 20s … if you are on your 30s probably you won’t enjoy this. There is fancier places to go like Perra Chica (good music, nice people and chic style)
A nice check-out , to recommend , the host made sure we had a dream time!!! Excellent !!!!

If you want to experience the nightlife in Madrid and meet great people, this is the trip for you. Our host Jonathan did an excellent job getting everyone together and showing us how to live it up in Madrid.
I absolutely love it. At the end of the night we all became friends and it was a moment that I’ll never forget. Just hated the first bar “chuupitos”

We were just staying for some days in Madrid so the pub crawl tour is a really good opportunity to meet new people!
It was pretty fun!:)
If you wanna spend an amazing night in Madrid, you have to join this group… everything was perfect. A special thanks to Will (our host). I recommend it highly

We had an excelent experience with Jonathan joining three pubs with free shots each time. We met new people and spend time discovering different cultures. I really recomand this guys if you want to have a party time in Madrid.
The host is very welcoming and down to earth, which made the vibe of the whole experience feel very fun and warm. Had a great time with several new friends
I enjoyed the experience got to meet some new people. Though it was a big group so it was hard to mingle with everyone but fun experience and nice way to meet new people
If you are new in Madrid or you are just passing by, it’s definitely a good “night” activity to meet people and have fun dancing!
Without a doubt, when I return to Madrid, I will do this departure again. You meet people from other countries, talks,dancing... and even go out with new friends. A 10!

I recommend the experience if you are traveling alone in Madrid. As you could meet some new people. But in my particular experience, the hosts didn't facilitate the integration of the group.
I was just expecting more integration, ice braking activities, games, etc. to make a closer group, and nothing of that happened.

Also it was not clearly stated that all the places we were going where kind of Pubs and none clubs. The last place we went was nice tho. The first two places not so worthy.

At the end it's good value for money and i can recommend
Maan i’m coming for weekend just for the pub crawl, they will make u feel like your city i would give them 100/100 no less

Highly recommended,if I could give 10 star i was give 10 star , janathan and will where very friendly, even when i was lost will came and take me to other bar,
Every bar you have shut of tequilas and before last bar they gave us free beer which wasn't included in tour but they were kind

Great tour of fun bars!

Madrid doesn’t really get going until after 10:30pm so don’t be surprised if bars are empty before then… they soon fill up!

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO ANYONE WHO SHOWS UP TO MADRID BY THEMSELVES - I MADE A COUPLE OF NEW FRIENDS AND I HAD TONS OF FUN!!!! DO NOT HESITATE ON BOOKING THIS BY YOURSELF OR AS A GROUP - JOHN AND WILL ARE GREAT HOST AND THEY TAKE U TO ALL THE RIGHT CLUBS!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
It was great, and a good old time. The cost per location at the door builds up. Wish the locations we visited were more unique.
We were a group of four and had a blast on this tour. Our guide were very welcoming and helpful! I would highly recommend this tour!
Friendly guys, a good chance to meet new people but not young most of the times over 26. Nice organisation from the leaders, it’s really nice when someone guide you in such a big city.

Will, Jonathan and Michael did an amazing job. It was so much fun and I meet new friends because of this tour. This guys are very entertaining and know how to party. During the tour William and Jonathan made sure everyone is together and got safe from one pub to the other. I absolutely recommend the tour to everyone who visits Madrid. Loved it

Had a really good time, really. The bars, the drinks and the vibe that this gathering provides will leave you wanting staying more time in Madrid to go to another gathering with Johnathan and Nandita, I highly recommend it

I had a great time ! They know how to party, took us to the best spots and gave us so much liquor. I definitely had a hangover the next day but that night was wild ! Expect to pay at some spots but it was like 10euros for a drink and shot! WORTH IT !
Enjoyed the experience. The hosts were super nice and friendly. My wife and I had a great time and we met new people. The experience was also great to map out Madrid’s night life.
A spectacular night, good music and a very good atmosphere for both dancing and meeting people. I had a great time!!

I wouldn’t recommend it. The club suggestions were disappointing. This was not a good clubbing experience at all imo. We had a better time finding clubs on our own by asking locals - I’d recommend that instead :)

At first I question my decision. But then I met new people got good drinks and then was more comfortable. It Is my first time in Madrid I felt I got to know nightlife much better through this than on my own or with other friends.
I had an amazing time. I traveled alone and was looking for cool people to spend my further time with. It surpassed my expectations. Thanks a lot Michael & Jonathan!

Super friendly, strong and smart. He was extremely accommodating and helped us have a great time in Madrid. He’s exceptionally well at making sure you have fun and changing plans according to your needs.

We had a fun night yesterday, thanks for the experience! If you wanna get to know people from all around the world and spend a great night together don’t hesitate to book this event😉 And also special thanks to our host Jonathan!
I had a LOT OF FUN! be prepared for not-so-cheap drinks, but the people in my group were amazing and had lots of fun.
This was a super fun experience with locals and others from around the world. Meeting people became the highlight of my trip and the drinks were a bonus.

The Pubcrawl was awesome and we had so much fun! Perfect for meeting new people from all over the world and Michael was an amazing host, super easy-going and fun. 100% recommended and will go again soon!

Amazing experience, friendly atmosphere and great customer service. Host Michael together with Jonathan and Andrea went way and beyond to ensure we are safe and enjoy our time. Thank you highly recommended.

One of a kind experience, if you like partying and meeting new people. Just follow the crowd don’t get lost and have your personal items with you at all time. You will have a good time. At the end of the day the experience is what you make of it.

Great experience! We ended up getting lost initially, but Michael worked hard to find us and made sure we were well taken care of the rest of the time. Thanks so much for a wonderful time and showing us amazing hospitality!

Michael and his crew were really amazing. Although me and my girlfriends showed up late to the meeting spot he back tracked to come and get us. He instantly got to know us and told us about himself. Brought us into the club with no issues and lines, introduced us to a bunch of the people who were there. Each time we all walked together we continued to learn more about the business, himself and Spain. Totally worth going and it gives you a great chance to meet new people and see some places you may have not expected to go! I would also recommend his other crawl for the Live Music Scene, really cool places, a totally different vibe from this one, but equally as awesome!

If you like to travel, make new friends, and have a couple of tequila shots during the process, then this is the perfect experience when visiting Madrid. Michael and his co-hosts really made me feel part of the group and like a VIP during the night as I had booked the experience through AirBnb. I made new friends and will won’t forget that night! Gracias Chicos!
So great! Book it. Just do it. You won't regret it. Such a great night. All the hosts that came on our adventure were helpful and fun!
Very good tour and Michael was a tremendous host, if I came back to Madrid again I wouldn't hesitate to buy the tour again, keep it up! 👍🏽

I was there with my boyfriend and we had a great evening! The registrations in AirBnb are still accompanied by spontaneous guests who come directly to the meeting point, so we were about 30 people in total. But it didn't bother us at all, because you got into a conversation with even more people from all over the world. We had a great time and would like to have the experience again next time in Madrid! Gracias a Michael y a su equipazo! :-)
Michael and his team were really nice and made sure that everybody was having fun. The crawl was so well organized. And the deal on drinks were great. I had a great night.

That was such a great experience, I have met really cool people from many countries and we went to good bars. I'll do it again for sure 😁
Thank you Michael !

Great experience ! We were able to enjoy our evening in Madrid more serenely thanks to the organization that was excellent ! The boxes we went to were great, the music was really good, better than in France by the way, and they really offered great deals compared to drinks ! We were able to chat easily with the people in the group and really practice English and/or Spanish. Thank you so much for offering this kind of party ! I would definitely stay again during my next stay in Madrid !

Guys....Look No Further. Michael is THE GUY for your night out in Madrid.....I couldn't have asked for anything better and had a rocking party all night on Friday. I will contact him directly next time i am in Madrid and will party with his gang. Met a lot of people, made new international friends, had an amazing time in the pubs we hopped to and danced to our hearts content. Brilliant host and ensured he had the gang with him all through the night.

It was a fun night; completely met our expectations. Mike was extremely friendly and made everybody feel comfortable. Special thanks to Carlos and Sarah from Mike's team as well for making the night so great.

What a fun experience!! I had a great evening making new friends and exploring the night life of Madrid. Thank you Michael for such a fun experience! Michael was engaged and so kind throughout the experience. I had a wonderful time. Highly recommend!

If you want to enjoy a wonderful night in Madrid, this is the best way to do so. It allows you to interact with more people who have the common interest. By the way, it takes you to places where the party does not end where good music and dance is not missing .
When you start the night you arrive alone, when it ends, you leave with new friends from different parts of the world, who will undoubtedly remember how to enjoy Madrid to the fullest .

In short, if you are looking to spend an experience after remembering, you must go and without fear of being mistaken you will want to repeat it .
Went in a group of 6, very accommodating. Met a few new people along the way. Clubs were hip, crowded but expected. Would recommend.
Hosts were so great! Very accommodating and made sure my friends and I had an excellent time. So worth it for our first night in Madrid.

I highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Madrid and wants to enjoy a fun night of partying and get a feel for the nightlife in Madrid. This was really fun. Michael took us to some cool clubs/ bars along with a large crowd of people all over the world.

We attended the tour on a Thursday night, and it was great. Unfortunately Michael was feeling under the weather the day of our tour. He met with my husband and I, plus some others in our group then had to leave. He did, however, leave us in good hands. Jonathan and Carlos took over our group and were so much fun. They can definitely hang. If you don’t like going out much, this probably isn’t the tour for you. If you are up for meeting new people, drinking, and staying up all night this is it. Ages in our group ranged from 28-34. It was a fun way to spend our first night in Madrid.
A very fun, enjoyable and varied experience. Michael and his group were always friendly. I highly recommend it

We participated as a group of three people and felt very welcomed. There were several group leaders which really cared about every single person. As a matter of fact it wasn't a problem to interact with the other participants, because the great atmosphere cheered everyone up.

We visited a couple of bars/clubs and allthough there were waiting lines, we hadn't any problems on entering. They even made sure that every member of the group would have been entered before they went in on their own.

In addition to the free shots and sangria out of a jar, there were special offers in nearly every location - but you don't have to claim them.

Tip: If you book the event via Airbnb, make sure to inform the host at the meeting point, so you won't be charged with an additional cost. As soon as we informed Michael, we immediately got our money back - a great act of friendship!
